summary: The checkpoint trim reports five fixed phase spans (trim.resume, trim.capture_plan, trim.record, trim.delete, trim.final_mark) in the profiler's existing wall, CPU and SQL accounting, so a long checkpoint task can be divided into its trim phases

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged; the profile record gains span names only when profiling is on.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change. The trim's source policy for chunk budgets, commits and order is unchanged; profiling can shift where timed chunk boundaries fall.

compatibility.detail: Nothing a client or peer sees changes.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
